description: A Spring Boot REST controller managing CRUD operations for questions and nested answers, including endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting questions and answers.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: REST controller for questions and answers, exposing CRUD endpoints.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists questions in a paginated manner, optionally including answers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific question by id, with optional inclusion of answers.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new question from provided DTO.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing question identified by id.

methods.name: listAnswers
methods.description: Lists all answers for a specific question.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Adds an answer to a specific question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Removes an answer from a question.
